name: Kulang Fort
description: Kulang is the third fort in the famous AMK (Alang-Madan-Kulang) circuit. It is known for its massive rock-cut steps, ancient water cisterns, and panoramic views. The trek is long and challenging, best suited for experienced trekkers.

routes.name: AMK Circuit
routes.description: Long approach, steep rock-cut steps, and exposed sections. Rope may be required in monsoon.

landmarks.name: Rock-cut Steps
landmarks.description: Massive steps carved into the rock, unique to Kulang.

landmarks.name: Water Cisterns
landmarks.description: Ancient cisterns with potable water most of the year.

landmarks.name: Summit Plateau
landmarks.description: Wide summit with views of Alang, Madan, and the Sahyadris.

history.significance: Strategic hill fort, part of the AMK circuit, used as a watchtower and refuge.

reviews: Kulang's rock-cut steps are a marvel. The climb is long but rewarding.
Water is usually available even in summer. The summit is perfect for camping.
Best done as part of the AMK circuit with experienced trekkers.
